description: Claude Code, headless. The prompt is the positional argument; the transcript is the stream-json output. `acceptEdits` plus the allow list lets the agent edit files and run shell commands without anyone to ask, which is a shell on this machine confined to the run directory only by the prompt: read benchmarks/harness/README.md, 'What the agent can touch', before the first run. `--tools` limits the built-in tools to what a prover needs (no artifact publishing, cron, messaging, remote triggers or workflows). The deny list closes the network and the routes to a mathlib download. `kill`, `pkill` and `killall` are denied: in the first full run the agent killed the harness by pid and then every `lean` and `lake` process of this user; it stops its own background commands with TaskStop. Subagent tools are denied unless the run passes --subagents.
